name: Alpha HPA Limited
summary: Alpha HPA Limited, an advanced material company, commercializes an application of solvent extraction to aluminium purification to produce ultra-high purity aluminium materials worldwide. It operates through HPA First and Alpha Sapphire segments. The company offers ultra-high purity alpha phase, gamma phase alumina, nano alumina, and pseudoboehmite powder; ultra-high purity alumina tablets; ultra-high purity aluminium nitrate A; aluminium nitrate nonahydrate; ultra-high purity alumina tri-hydrate; and synthetic sapphire material, as well as aluminium hydroxide.
